_howto: Cheat sheet. tabs = the three outcomes (with their main signal). cards: tab = which tab it shows under; signal = the extra (secondary) signal key from signals.json, or leave it out if the ref just gives the main signal; link = optional page link.

cards.name: Offside (general play)
cards.what: You're in front of a teammate who has the ball or just kicked it, and you get involved.
cards.avoid: Get back behind the ball before you play.

cards.name: Offside at the ruck or maul
cards.what: You're in front of the back foot of the ruck or maul.
cards.avoid: Get behind the back foot. If you're not in the ruck, stand behind it.

cards.name: Not releasing (tackler)
cards.what: The tackler holds on to the tackled player after they're on the ground.
cards.avoid: Let go right away, then get up before you play the ball.

cards.name: Holding on (tackled player)
cards.what: The tackled player hangs on to the ball instead of placing or passing it.
cards.avoid: Place or pass the ball the moment you hit the ground.

cards.name: Not rolling away
cards.what: A player on the ground (often the tackler) stays near the ball and gets in the way.
cards.avoid: Roll away from the ball, fast.

cards.name: Off your feet (sealing off)
cards.what: Diving or flopping over the ball so the other team can't get it. The ref will shout "Stay on your feet!"
cards.avoid: Stay on your feet and bind on.

cards.name: Hands in the ruck
cards.what: Picking up or playing the ball with your hands once a ruck has formed.
cards.avoid: No hands in the ruck. Use your feet, or wait for it to come out.

cards.name: Coming in from the side
cards.what: Joining a ruck, maul, or tackle from the side instead of from behind.
cards.avoid: Come through the gate, from directly behind.

cards.name: High tackle
cards.what: Making contact above the line of the shoulders.

cards.name: Dangerous tackle
cards.what: Tipping or dropping a player, tackling without using your arms, or tackling a player in the air.
cards.avoid: Wrap with your arms, drive with your legs, and never lift and drop.

cards.name: Collapsing the scrum
cards.what: Pulling down, dropping, or letting the scrum go to ground on purpose.
cards.avoid: Keep your bind and your body height. Hips just above knees, flat back.

cards.name: Obstruction
cards.what: Blocking a defender who is trying to get to the ball carrier.
cards.avoid: Don't run in front of your ball carrier or block defenders.

cards.name: Not retreating 10 meters
cards.what: The team that gave away the penalty doesn't back off 10 meters.
cards.avoid: Sprint back 10 meters right away, even if you're tired. If you don't, the penalty moves 10 meters closer.

cards.name: Early engagement at the scrum
cards.what: Pushing into the scrum before the ref calls "Set."
cards.avoid: Wait for Crouch, Bind, Set. Engage only on Set.

cards.name: Crooked feed
cards.what: The 9 doesn't put the ball into the scrum straight.
cards.avoid: 9: feed it straight down the middle.

cards.name: Closing the gap at the lineout
cards.what: Players close the 1 meter gap between the two lines before the ball is thrown.
cards.avoid: Hold your line until the ball is in.

cards.name: Knock-on
cards.what: Dropping or knocking the ball forward.
cards.avoid: Watch the ball into your hands. Hands up early.

cards.name: Forward pass
cards.avoid: Pass flat or backward. Run onto the ball.

cards.name: Not straight at the lineout
cards.what: The throw doesn't go straight down the middle. The other team chooses a lineout throw or a scrum.
cards.avoid: Hooker: practice a straight throw down the middle.

tabs.name: Penalty
tabs.text: Serious foul. The other team chooses: kick at goal, kick to touch, tap and go, or scrum.

tabs.name: Free kick
tabs.text: Smaller foul, usually at a scrum or lineout. Like a penalty, but they can't kick at goal.

tabs.name: Scrum
tabs.text: Accidental mistake, like a knock-on. Scrum to the other team (not a penalty).
